data_description.contract_kw: The power of your electricity contract (e.g. 3 kW). Used only to suggest the thresholds: switch-off +10%, urgent +30%, restore 93%. You can change them later from the dashboard.
data_description.meter: Sensor with the power drawn by the whole house right now, in W or kW (e.g. the meter reader, a Shelly EM, a clamp meter). Not an energy sensor in kWh.
data_description.restore_previous: Found from an earlier installation: loads ({loads}), power sensors, notifications, thresholds and switches. Turn off to start from scratch.

user.description:
Power Control watches the power used by the whole house and, when it goes over the limit of your contract, switches loads off one at a time, in the order you choose, before the meter trips. When consumption is back to normal it switches them back on, one at a time and only if they fit.

After this step open the settings (cog icon) to choose the loads, their power sensors, the notifications and the presence sensors.
user.title: Power Control

invalid_thresholds.message: The thresholds must be: restore ({restore} W) < switch-off ({shed} W) < urgent ({urgent} W).

data_description.cancel_delay: How long consumption must stay below the switch-off threshold to cancel a running countdown.
data_description.min_active_w: A load that is on but draws less than this (standby) is skipped.
data_description.restore_delay: How long consumption must stay below the restore threshold before switching loads back on.
data_description.shed_interval: Time to let the meter update after each switch-off or switch-on.
data_description.urgent_delay: As soon as consumption goes over the urgent threshold a notification is sent at once; the first load is switched off only if consumption stays over it for all this time (if it drops, the count starts again). Short peaks, like a kettle or an oven heating up, are ignored.
data_description.warning_minutes: Minutes before the switch-off when the warning is sent.
data_description.meter: The sensor with the power of the whole house (W or kW). Change it here if you replace it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Fine-tuning: the defaults suit most homes.

init.title: Power Control settings
init.description:
Each section is saved as soon as you confirm it: closing this window loses nothing already confirmed.

Suggested order: Loads → Power sensors → Notifications → Presence at home.

data_description.loads: Drag to change the order: the first is the first to be switched off and the last to be switched back on. Saved as soon as you confirm; the power sensors are in their own section.

loads.title: Loads and switch-off order
loads.description: Choose the devices Power Control may switch off: smart plugs, switches, lights, air conditioners, dehumidifiers, water heaters, fans… Loads that are off or in standby are skipped.

data_description.notify_only_home: When on, a phone is skipped while its owner is away. Who is at home comes from the sensor chosen in "Presence at home"; if none is chosen it is found automatically for Companion app phones. A phone with no presence sensor always gets the notifications.
data_description.voice_players: Alexa devices use Alexa Media Player; other speakers need a text-to-speech engine.
data_description.notify_services: Phones with the Home Assistant Companion app appear as notify.mobile_app_phone_name; other notification services work too.
data_description.tts_entity: Needed only for speakers that are not Alexa (Google, Sonos…), e.g. tts.google_translate_say or tts.home_assistant_cloud.
data_description.voice_start: Voice announcements are made only in this time window; phone notifications always arrive.
data_description.voice_end: Same time as the start = announcements at any time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Where Power Control sends its messages. Every message is also fired as the power_control_event event, for your own automations.

data.no_restore: Never switch these back on automatically

sensors.title: Power sensors and automatic restore

data_description.no_restore: Switched off when needed but never switched back on by Power Control: you switch them on by hand.

presence.title: Presence at home
presence.description:
Used only when "Only to people at home" is on in Notifications.

For each phone choose the sensor telling whether its owner is at home: a person (recommended), a device tracker, or a binary sensor / input boolean that is on when at home.

Leave it empty to use the one found automatically:
{auto}

Where there is none (—) that phone always gets the notifications: nothing is filtered.
